title: Override Just One Heading
prompt:
Three `h2` headings share a style: `h2 { color: seagreen; }` — already written for you. The heading with id `featured` must instead be `crimson`, and your override must beat the element selector.

Rules:
- Keep the given rule untouched.
- Add one rule that wins over `h2` for `#featured`.
boilerplate:
Fresh bread

Sourdough of the week

Croissants

tests.name: original rule survives
tests.hint: Don't modify the given rule — add, don't replace.

tests.name: #featured override wins
tests.hint: #featured { color: crimson; } — id specificity (1,0,0) beats element (0,0,1).

tests.name: no !important shortcuts
tests.hint: The id selector alone outranks the element selector. No !important needed.
